gen-fs-oswald-gf-mooli: Mooli opens its round letters wide and stays legible when small. Oswald stacks its tight, confident rows above it, and that firm pairing of a strong display voice with gentle text is the best thing here.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-murecho: Murecho reads modern and clean, its s curves swinging open at both ends so each line feels unhurried. Oswald's tight, strong rows sit above it.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-nanum-gothic: Oswald is all confident, tightly knit rows, a display face with real muscle. Nanum Gothic follows with wide channels leading into each counter, so a long passage would read in a smooth, professional way.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-national-park: Oswald's tightly knit rows give it a strong, confident look, with a lighter line weight than the body. And National Park answers with a ruler-straight pen and rounded letters open on one side, which keeps the text feeling clean.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-niramit: Oswald's rows sit tightly knit and confident, built for display. Niramit follows with gaping letter curves, so a long passage would feel clean, professional and easy to move through.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-canadian-abor: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal reads neutral and contemporary, with every curve ending open. And if Oswald were made small, its tight, strong rows would lose the presence they have up top.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Noto Sans Cypriot reads clean and approachable, its e opening up instead of closing its eye in a knot. Oswald's tight rows add the muscle.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan reads contemporary and professional, with cut-back terminals leaving a big gap. Over a longer stretch those open endings keep the text breathing, while Oswald's tightly knit confident rows stay firmly up top.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohing: Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya reads approachable and modern, its c visibly gaping at any size, which gives the text a friendly face. Oswald's strong rows lead.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Oswald sets confident, tightly knit rows with real strength. Noto Sans Hatran has a wide, funnel-like throat in the e, so a longer passage would read in an approachable, neutral way.
